scripts.setup: pnpm install && (cd web && pnpm install) && (cd api && uv sync)
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c yellow,blue "cd web && pnpm dev --port 10001" "cd api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 20001 --reload"
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c yellow,blue "cd web && pnpm preview --port 10001" "cd api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 20001"
scripts.format:read: (cd web && pnpm exec prettier --check .) && (cd api && uv run ruff format --check .)
scripts.format:write: (cd web && pnpm exec prettier --write .) && (cd api && uv run ruff format .)
scripts.lint:read: (cd web && pnpm run lint) && (cd api && uv run ruff check .)
scripts.lint:write: (cd web && pnpm exec eslint --fix .) && (cd api && uv run ruff check --fix .)
